business_problem: FC Bayern had a fragmented business and fan-data landscape, with HR, expense, merchandising, ticketing, and stadium systems operating in silos and relying on manual spreadsheet-heavy processes that limited visibility, slowed employees, and made it hard to personalize fan engagement at global scale.
solution_summary: FC Bayern used SAP Business Suite to replace disconnected business systems with a connected digital core. SAP S/4HANA serves as the cloud ERP foundation for finance, partner management, merchandising fulfillment, and supply chain processes. SAP Integration Suite links payroll, financial accounting, stadium operations, ticketing, merchandising, and other systems, while SAP Datasphere brings SAP and non-SAP data into a unified self-service data layer that feeds SAP Analytics Cloud for finance, fan engagement, and scouting analysis. SAP Business Technology Platform provides the common application foundation, SAP SuccessFactors HCM modernizes hire-to-retire HR, SAP Concur digitizes expenses, SAP Customer Checkout handles matchday point-of-sale activity, SAP Engagement Cloud activates the golden fan record for omnichannel campaigns, and SAP Sports One manages training, medical, and scouting workflows.

data_flow: Data from payroll, finance, stadium operations, ticketing, merchandising, HR, and other SAP and non-SAP systems is connected through SAP Integration Suite and unified in SAP Datasphere. SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Engagement Cloud consume that shared data for insights and personalized fan campaigns, while SAP Customer Checkout, SAP SuccessFactors HCM, SAP Concur, and SAP Sports One execute matchday, employee, expense, and sports-performance workflows.
business_outcome: FC Bayern consolidated 52 systems and more than 9.5 million records into a golden fan record, supports 50,000 matchday transactions at the Allianz Arena, improved HR and expense workflows for 1,000 employees, and can deliver personalized omnichannel fan engagement while running scouting and performance processes from one connected platform.

evidence_quotes: SAP Datasphere simplifies FC Bayern’s data landscape by integrating both SAP and non-SAP data in a unified, self-service environment.
By connecting payroll, financial accounting, stadium operations, and other systems, SAP Integration Suite improves both internal workflows and the fan experience on matchdays.
By consolidating data from 52 systems and more than 9.5 million records, the club created a single “golden fan record.”

With SAP Engagement Cloud, this complete view of fan preferences and behaviors helps FC Bayern run highly personalized, omnichannel marketing campaigns to connect with fans on their preferred digital channels.
At the Allianz Arena, SAP Customer Checkout centralizes sales transactions, inventory, and customer information on one platform, allowing fans to focus on what matters most—the game.
With SAP Sports One, the club coordinates administrative, training, and team performance management, and medical processes on one platform.
Smooth integration of SAP Concur into FC Bayern’s ecosystem reduces errors and speeds expense claims.
